text:
nina_sales: Quick update - CortexPay's AWS Marketplace listing is live and they've agreed to a 12-month renewal for Dedicated + Private (VPC). Big win for GTM and compliance customers. :rocket:

marketplace-bot: AWS listing published: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-cortexpay-redwood (SKU: RDW-CP-2026-AWS)

eva_csm: CortexPay CSM just sent a short customer line we can quote: "Redwood helped us move latency-sensitive fraud detection to production in 10 days; 40% lower p99 and ~22% reduction in per-transaction inference cost." They also approved logo use.

tia_pmm: Amazing. i'll draft a 1-pager case study and hero quote. Need legal sign-off on the exact wording and a high-res logo from CortexPay. @sylvia_legal can you review the quote and approve by EOD Thu?

sylvia_legal: happy to. please send the proposed copy here and confirm CortexPay's marketing opt-in (they signed it in the renewal doc).

jared_eng: Infra notes: Dedicated pool deployed in us-east-1 with 6xA10G steady, autoscale to 10 during peak. Private (VPC) control plane connected and audit logs enabled. I've added a routing policy so payment flows prefer the low-latency AZs.

ops-bot: Deployment completed: dedicated-pool-cortexpay-us-east-1 - status: healthy. Metrics streaming to Grafana (dashboard: /d/cortexpay-routing).

eva_csm: CortexPay also provided a technical blurb: "The Redwood KV cache and batching saved us from a 2x cost spike during our simulated peak tests." We can use that in the case study too if legal is ok.

tia_pmm: plan: 1) case study live on site, 2) co-authored blog post with CortexPay, 3) social + partner co-post, 4) marketplace spotlight. Target publish date: next Wednesday. Can design and comms review by Monday?

nina_sales: timeline works for sales outreach. i'll update the renewal record (ARR $240k) and add links to the case study when it's live. Can someone draft a short internal blurb for all-hands? execs want to highlight marketplace traction.

sylvia_legal: approved the quote with minor edits (removing the exact % language to keep it high-level). Sent the redline to @eva_csm for customer approval.

eva_csm: CortexPay accepted the edits and signed off on the final quote + logo pack.

tia_pmm: drafting the all-hands blurb: "CortexPay renewal + AWS Marketplace listing — drives $240k ARR; showcases Dedicated+Private for regulated fintechs." Will circulate for review by end of day.

jared_eng: ops reminder: when we start the co-marketing push, watch for cold-starts from partner traffic. i'll add a temporary warmup policy and a dashboard alert for >15% increase in cold starts over baseline.

ops-bot: Alert created: cortexpay-coldstart-spike - notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-runtime.

nina_sales: marketing ask: please queue partner co-post outreach; i'll coordinate with CortexPay marketing lead (Samir). Also add this to the Partner Wins doc and the GTM deck.

tia_pmm: will do. cc'ing Marketplace PM to request an AWS feature spotlight.

marketplace-bot: Partner channel created: #partner-cortexpay-1760123456 - invites sent to CortexPay, sales, PMM, legal, and ops.

eva_csm: big thanks to the CSM, sales, and runtime teams — smooth migration and quick turnaround.

nina_sales: nice work team :tada: - i'll follow up with a short handoff to customer success for onboarding cadence and success metrics tracking.
